title: Quickplay Storyboard for Optimize Toolkit — contextual batching & quantization tradeoff flows
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Design a compact, first-run 'Quickplay' storyboard for the Optimize toolkit that surfaces contextual batching and KV cache recommendations and introduces a quantization tradeoff control. The flow should be scannable, work as a micro-interaction within the onboarding modal, and provide lightweight links to deeper docs and a cost/latency preview. Deliverables include high-fidelity screens, micro-animation specs, annotated screenshots for docs, and developer redlines for the console UI.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with 6 storyboard steps (intro, workload analyzer, batching rec, kv warmup, quant tradeoff slider, completion) published and commented
Exported PNGs for each step plus dark-mode variants (2x and 1x) in the handoff folder
Interaction spec: micro-animations (fade+slide, tradeoff scrub), timing, and accessible labels documented
Annotated screenshot pack (for docs) with callouts for copy, token budgets, and links to evals
Developer redlines (spacing, responsive breakpoints, CSS token references) added to Confluence and referenced in the PR
PM and Eng sign-off recorded in comments
design_notes: Prioritize immediate value: show a one-line estimate for cost delta when user toggles batching or quantization
Tradeoff slider should show three live metrics: median latency, estimated cost per 1k tokens, and quality delta (from evaluation set) — use small sparkline icons
KV warmup step should include a 'preview warmup' affordance that simulates hit-rate improvement with example prefix
Keep the storyboard under 600ms perceived transition time for each micro-step to preserve onboarding flow speed
Include fallback copy for users on Dedicated/Private deployments where auto-quantization may be disabled

decisions: Use a non-blocking micro-modal for Quickplay so users can dismiss and return later
Quantization UI will be a preview-first control (preview quality delta from a representative eval) with an 'Apply' CTA that triggers the recommended config
Batching recommendation will surface one default suggested profile and an 'advanced' accordion for manual tuning
